entries.reason: The Windows ZIP includes the separately published matching v1.1 native Xbox port build as a setup companion. The flagged Xbox program has identical bytes in both packages. The required retail original is a PS2 disc supplied by the player.
The only signal is xboxrecomp/tools/conformance/test.xbe, the 4,176-byte SYNTH test fixture. The member hash matches the test fixture in the exact v0.1.0 xboxrecomp submodule revision.
